# NBA 2K26: MyTEAM Courtside Report

SHARE ON SOCIAL

NBA 2K26 brings NBA and WNBA players together for the first time in MyTEAM. Collect player cards from both leagues and compete with unique lineup combinations.

Accept & Play

By clicking play, you agree to [YouTube's privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy) and the transfer of data to Google servers.

###### Table of Contents

- [ALL-NEW GAME CHANGER CARDS](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#all-new-game-changer-cards)
- [TRIPLE THREAT PARK AT NIGHT](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#triple-threat-park-at-night)
- [ALL-STAR TEAM-UP\*](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#all-star-team-up)
- [KING OF THE COURT, PRESENTED BY AT&T](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#king-of-the-court)
- [BREAKOUT: GAUNTLET](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#breakout-gauntlet)
- [SINGLE PLAYER SALARY CAP](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#single-player-salary-cap)
- [GETTING STARTED](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#getting-started)
- [MyTEAM ARENA](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#myteam-arena)
- [COACH DEVELOPMENT](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#coach-development)
- [VICTORY CARDS & THE EXCHANGE](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#victory-cards)
- [MyTEAM REP](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myteam/#myteam-rep)

The MyTEAM NBA-WNBA crossover is officially happening in _NBA 2K26_, across all Gen 9 and Gen 8 platforms.

For the first time ever, you’ll be able to collect and play with WNBA Player Cards, and pair them with your favorite NBA superstars on the same team. This is a massive milestone in _NBA 2K_ history and it’s been a long time coming.

While this is a major addition, it’s not the only one in _2K26_. This year features new Game Changer Cards, All-Star Team-Up, a new arena featuring your MyTEAM accolades, and much more! So without further ado, let’s break down MyTEAM in _NBA 2K26_.

## **THE WNBA JOINS MyTEAM**

For the first time in _NBA 2K_ history, the WNBA is officially joining MyTEAM in _NBA 2K26_!

This monumental milestone means that you can form unique pairings between Jalen Brunson and Angel Reese, Lisa Leslie and Nikola Jokić, and countless others! Imagine throwing a lob with Paige Bueckers to Cooper Flagg, or torching the defense dropping 4-pointers with Stephen Curry and Caitlin Clark as your backcourt tandem.

The WNBA is fully integrated into every aspect of MyTEAM’s features and game modes. Experiment with lineup combinations the sport has never seen before and get creative as you find the perfect balance for each format.

Attributes and Badges function identically for all WNBA and NBA Player Cards, ensuring a balanced and consistent gameplay experience regardless of who you’re controlling. In addition to mixing and matching WNBA and NBA superstars, all WNBA uniforms have been added along with the entire league’s set of court floors. These courts include an added NBA three-point line to maintain a seamless experience across all MyTEAM competitive modes.

Now with WNBA inclusion in MyTEAM, we’ve added a dedicated WNBA Domination tier, where you can compete against the league using a lineup of WNBA stars. Create a lineup featuring exclusively WNBA players and challenge teams around the Association to earn those coveted Domination stars and crests for rewards.

These never-before-seen lineups wouldn’t be the same without a colorful broadcast crew to capture the magnitude of NBA and WNBA players competing side-by-side. _NBA 2K26_ presentation has been updated with the iconic voices of Kevin Harlan, Greg Anthony, and Stan Van Gundy, including new commentary and reactions to deliver their patented dynamic and insightful coverage.\* Feel the energy and excitement of WNBA and NBA stars coming together in this groundbreaking MyTEAM development.

## ALL-NEW GAME CHANGER CARDS

WNBA Player Cards entering the MyTEAM landscape will open the realm of possibility in Domination and throughout the entire mode—but they’re not the only difference-maker being introduced in _2K26_.

This year welcomes all-new Game Changer Cards, a brand new type of card that’s different from anything you’ve ever encountered before. These cards give you the power to cater your MyTEAM experience to your liking, with increased rewards and making your Player Cards more powerful.

These consumable cards grant special power-ups, including:

- Activating a REP or MyTEAM Points multiplier for your next game.
- Recovering a win streak in Showdown after a loss.
- Auto-winning a Breakout game without playing it.
- Earning an extra prize or recovering a loss during a Breakout run.
- Instantly completing an Exhibition Mission.
- Auto-evolving an Evolution card.
- Reducing the difficulty or target score differential in Domination.
- …and **_dozens_** more!

![ALL-NEW GAME CHANGER CARDS](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/6g8Won0ahSpp8MeEqjtTwI/fb854a9d62ba402284a0db0c24623994/N26-ALL-GAME_CHANGER_CARDS-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1080x1920-FINAL.jpg)

MyTEAM in _2K26_ is a game changer, literally and figuratively. Approach the game with the mindset to break the mold and play your way. Rethink the way MyTEAM is played and find an angle that no one else has discovered.

Get a head start with Game Changer cards in _NBA 2K26_ by completing the _2K26_ Challenge in _2K25_’s MyTEAM right now! On top of selecting an All-Star Series 1 player for your collection, you will also receive 5 Game Changer cards that each double your MyTEAM Points earned in a game in various MyTEAM modes. This is a great way to get started and build your MTP for the Auction House! Learn how to participate in the challenge below:

1. Enter Locker Code "2K26-COVER-ATHLETES-MyTEAM" for a 100 OVR Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Invincible Carmelo Anthony, and Pink Diamond Angel Reese Coach Card in _2K25_.
2. Head to Lifetime Challenges in MyTEAM and play the " _2K26_ MyTEAM Challenge" using 100 OVR Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Invincible Carmelo Anthony in your lineup.
3. Defeat previous _NBA 2K_ cover athletes in a Triple Threat game to 21 points and earn Invincible Devin Booker.
4. When you download and play _2K26_, an All-Star Option Pack and 5 Game Changer cards will be waiting for you.

Make sure to take advantage of this offer before it expires on Friday, August 22, 2025 at 8 a.m. PT!

## TRIPLE THREAT PARK AT NIGHT\*

In _NBA 2K26_ the sound of waves lapping and the sunbaked courts from _NBA 2K15_’s Sunset Beach are returning with a remixed look and feel. When the sun sets on this gorgeous venue, Triple Threat Park will come alive with neon lights that accent the tropical environment.

Triple Threat Park boasts four head-to-head 3v3 courts, including a new one on the newly opened boardwalk near the beach. At the center of the park, there are three 3v3 courts for 6-player co-op games.

Based on community feedback, the top REP player on your team will provide your uniforms and the top REP player in the game will bring their basketball.

![TRIPLE THREAT PARK AT NIGHT](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/19wOpdwTkLSGh6eON3ohd1/89deddbde96cf9f71379cb128d1599a5/N25-ALL-TRIPLE_THREAT_PARK_ENVIRONMENT-NA-06-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-644x424-FINAL.gif)

###### **Team Up in 2v2**

Another first in MyTEAM: 2v2 games!

By the MyTEAM Store and Showcase Spot, you’ll find two all-new 2v2 half-courts in the middle of the street with chain nets.

These are co-op style games, where each person controls 1 Player Card. Grab your duo and lock in for “make it, take it” games where every possession matters.

###### **More Rewards**

Community-favorite reward mechanics for going on win streaks and climbing the seasonal wins ladder return and are expanded. Daily Win Streak rewards can now stretch beyond the three prizes earned every day during _2K25_, with even more prizing available each day and during events in _2K26_.

Earn more rewards with every W each Season, with Seasonal Ladder prizes available directly from the Triple Threat Park menu. In addition to easily accessible rewards, the final reward of each Season is repeatable for unlimited rewards!

Finally, daily Streak Busters are coming to Triple Threat Park. These are rewards for shutting down win streaks of increasing length. When you break an opponent’s streak, you’ll earn all the rewards from the tiers below. For example, if you break a 15-game streak, you’ll earn the rewards for breaking a 5-game, 10-game, and 15-game streak all at once.

## ALL-STAR TEAM-UP\*

Tell your friends: MyTEAM is the new home of All-Star Team-Up in _2K26_!

In All-Star Team-Up you can compete in 10-player, 5v5 co-op games with your friends, or random players. These fast-paced games feature 6-minute halves and can be accessed from a portal in Triple Threat Park or from the MyTEAM menu.

![LOBBY ](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1LiFgljsf6DbWnOwfCGL7c/fb374384316c3e1b582e81ac4ef713d4/N25-ALL-ASTU_LOBBY-NA-06-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-644x424-FINAL.gif)

All-Star Team-Up requires that you and four teammates each prioritize your five favorite NBA or WNBA Player Cards—they must be position eligible—and just like in Triple Threat Park, whoever has the highest REP will have the first choice.

Accumulate new rewards individually with a new Season Ladder, with the same repeating final prize mechanic as Triple Threat Park.

You can also earn rewards as a team by defeating opposing teams to collect wins. For every 5 games you win with the same squad, everyone will receive a reward, even if the wins aren’t consecutive. Develop chemistry on the court with your squad and climb the Seasonal rewards ladder together.

## KING OF THE COURT, PRESENTED BY AT&T\*\*

King of the Court is where the best of the best in MyTEAM compete for the best rewards and we’re taking it to the next level on Gen 9 platforms.

In _NBA 2K26_, King of the Court boasts a $10,000 USD (and 1 Million VC) grand prize every weekend for the No. 1 finisher across PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X\|S, from September 12 through August 2. No. 1 finishers on PC and Nintendo Switch 2 will each receive 1 Million VC.

Based on community feedback, it is now easier to participate. First, we’ve expanded King of the Court to take place during a full-weekend window, starting Fridays at 3:00 pm Pacific Time until Sundays at 11:59 pm Pacific Time, to be more accessible.

The qualification criteria is also simpler and now checks to see how much REP you’ve earned in the preceding week, allowing you to qualify by playing in any MyTEAM mode or by completing Challenges.

Once you enter King of the Court games, you will notice that the game difficulty will be set to a more competitive slider set compared to MyTEAM’s other multiplayer modes. Be sure to practice your Player Cards’ shots before jumping in!

The leaderboard ranks the sum of each player’s four best Game Scores during that weekend, with four tiers of rewards each event. Three losses will freeze your score, similar to _2K25_. Tier requirements are loosely based on the 1%, 10%, and 50% thresholds from _2K25_; however, they will lock in hours before the end of the event to prevent score fluctuation as the remaining games are finalized at the buzzer.

Continue beating your own high scores to climb the leaderboard. Even if you don’t win the grand prize, everyone who qualifies and plays three games, win or lose, takes home a reward.

## _BREAKOUT: GAUNTLET_

Another new game mode within Breakout is Gauntlet, where you put your entire collection to the test by completing games of increasing difficulty.

Gauntlet features a new straight-line game board—but there’s a twist. As you progress from Rookie difficulty to more challenging difficulties, you’ll only be able to use each of your Player Cards once per run. With Triple Threat, Clutch Time, and quick Full Lineup games, depth is your friend in this game mode, but so is understanding how to maximize every card in your collection.

Each game has Objectives that can be completed to return eligibility for a random card you’ve already used during this run. As the difficulty gets higher, more Objectives will become available each game, giving you more opportunities to gain back some of your used Player Cards.

The longer you continue a run, the better the rewards will be with a regularly updated final reward at the end of the path. There are prize games along the sides of the board every three spots, so after every three wins, you can optionally go up against gatekeeper teams to earn  rewards.

![BREAKOUT: GAUNTLET](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/6ElmSAxZpsDYzTllR0wkod/1334f61737132ec4b7320878373d39ed/N26-ALL-BREAKOUT_GAUNTLET-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

###### **More Breakout Improvements**

Based on community feedback, Breakout as a whole is even more rewarding in _2K26_. Facing a gatekeeper team in Breakout no longer ends your run and instead takes away one of your three allowed prizes or losses, so you can continue playing on boards to earn up to three rewards in each run.

As you unlock neighboring spots on Breakout boards, you’ll notice new reward mini-game spots to receive Ball Drops, Ascension picks, Wheel Spins, Door Game searches, or Vault openings! Redeeming these free spots does not count towards your three prizes or losses per run—they’re simply more rewards available on the board!

With these free spots being added, it could be a lot more difficult to trigger warps to other boards with fewer games available. To counter this, Breakout will see more focused and frequent updates to the lineup classes available on the initial board. Teams from the 1980s may be featured with their warp board available, while another update could see brand new lineup classes added with never-before-seen opponents for your lineups. New triggers have also been added to generate warps, but those will need to be discovered by the community.

## SINGLE PLAYER SALARY CAP

Salary Cap mode returns in _NBA 2K26_—now with the option to play in single player games. The AI opponents you’ll face in single player games are real lineups created by other community members under the same salary cap restrictions.

Both single-player Salary Cap and multiplayer Salary Cap Online feature the same rewards track, but multiplayer games grant double Round Points for faster progression. Higher single-player difficulties also have the ability to speed up your progress in comparison to lower difficulties.

Similar to the updates in Triple Threat Park and All-Star Team-Up, Salary Cap’s round-based prizing will also include a repeatable final reward, just in case you can’t get enough Salary Cap action with its unique game format of two halves and a fixed-score ending.

Bridge the gap between single-player and multiplayer modes to keep things fresh and exciting in _2K26_.

## **GETTING STARTED**

At the start of your MyTEAM journey, choose between two 5-card lineups to play as, each with a mix of current and historic NBA and WNBA players.

Test these cards in a quick, 3-minute game and afterwards you’ll receive two Free Agent Option Packs, one with Diamond-rated Current Players that can be used for 25 games, and the other with Pink Diamond-rated Legend Players that can be used for 15 games. These option packs will include the NBA and WNBA cards in the game you just played.

For new or returning players, start your collection with rewards from the MyTEAM Tutorial. Here, you will experience the basics of MyTEAM _2K26_, from the new Coaching staff features, upgrading your player cards, and earning a Clutch Time lineup’s worth of players. Plus, this is how you earn the first of the five traditional evolution Starter players!

## MyTEAM ARENA\*

Bask in all of your achievements in the new starting location on Gen 9 platforms—the MyTEAM Arena.

This arena proudly displays banners, trophies, and murals from all of your accomplishments on the court and across the mode. This includes reaching Level 40 in a Season, getting promoted to Tier 1 in Showdown, collecting all the Player Card gems, completing feats across all MyTEAM modes, and more. Plus, there are special additions for the talented few that win King of the Court, or reach the Dark Matter Tier in MyTEAM REP.

Your MyTEAM Arena features lots of natural light and stunning views of the neighboring buildings. Pack your stadium with dedicated fans as you progress and continue playing MyTEAM.

The MyTEAM Arena is the initial home for every MyTEAM this year. NBA arenas will still be available to swap in, but the MyTEAM Arena is your trophy room and home turf.

![MyTEAM ARENA](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/43pxcR0FMfFnqb6gf1Ye45/2587027e1663ccd6266025d531a0f031/N26-ALL-MYTEAM_ARENA-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

## COACH DEVELOPMENT

In addition to getting Badge Cards from packs or the Auction House, there is a new way you can invest in and improve your Player Cards. In _2K26_, you can build out your coaching staff with up to five Coach Cards and expand a new skill tree to unlock powerful badges to add to your Player Cards.

Coach Cards now have five categories for you to prioritize: Strategy, Leadership, Mentorship, Knowledge, and Team Management. You choose which category to assign your coach in your franchise, which will unlock Badge Training Challenges. The higher your Coach Card’s gem level & skills, the more powerful badges you can access by redeeming Coach Points.

Coach Points will be made available at every REP tier and from Season Rewards. Redeem them wisely in your coach’s assigned category to unlock the badges that will help your Player Cards the most. If you decide to make a coaching change, your unlocked progress will remain even if you decide to swap Coach Cards or move your coach to a different category. As you increase your REP level, you will open more slots to add to your coaching staff, making more Badge Training Challenges available.

Once unlocked, Badge Training Challenges can be started from the Challenges menu. Select which player you want to add the badge to and complete an in-game challenge with them to add it, no Badge Cards required!

Coach Cards will continue to provide in-game boosts in certain situations or for the entire game. If you have multiple active Coach Cards on your staff, selecting a Head Coach will grant access to that coach’s in-game boost.

![COACH DEVELOPMENT](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/52uAqFgdNBJzV2raZkWwE6/d3970ae3a7e329fc511f56f70eec74a4/N26-ALL-COACH_DEVELOPMENT-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

## VICTORY CARDS & THE EXCHANGE

When you win a game in MyTEAM’s competitive modes (Showdown, Salary Cap Online, and King of the Court) you will earn a Victory Card that not only has the REP gem tier of the opponent you beat, but also their team logo, game date, final score, game mode, and whether or not the opponent rage quit!

Conquer opponents with high REP levels, collect their Victory Cards, and exchange them for rewards in The Exchange.

![VICTORY CARD](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1nzbRM3Ps8B0YxZk0HcZps/2a6d479b34911d4f38ac97d4b2a79237/N26-ALL-VICTORY_CARDS_AND_THE_EXCHANGE-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

There are also new ways to exchange your cards and receive rewards for duplicates or unused cards in your collection.

New OVR-based Exchanges may accept player cards of any gem tier, but the average rating of those cards must meet a minimum OVR rating. Exchange Chains must be done consecutively for more powerful rewards. Finally, Exchange Groups are multiple exchanges within a category and completing them all will earn you an additional group reward.

Based on community feedback, Exchanges can now also access the cards in your My Auctions menu (which can again be expanded by REPing up this year) where more cards can be stored before being swapped for rewards.

## MyTEAM REP

REP is a status indicator in many respects throughout MyTEAM, and to see so many members of the community showcase their REP rewards, like the MyTEAM Coliseum and player banners, means a lot to us here at Visual Concepts. We’re excited to immortalize our Top REP players from _2K25_ on the Top REP Court which is included in everyone’s starter kit in _2K26_.

Shortening the grind between REP rewards was a common feedback item from the community. This year, many of the REP tiers now have multiple sub-tiers so that you can earn more rewards, more often.

Reach Dark Matter REP in 2K26 to earn a group of truly ‘Out of this World’ rewards, and one of the most iconic Carmelo Anthony aliases of all time: **_G.O.A.T. Hoodie Melo!_**

![G.O.A.T. Hoodie Melo](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/zXk4VMkTv9psuR1muULeL/43e5551da1a0190708d3ef4decf7f245/N26-ALL-HOODIE_MELO-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

## …AND MORE!

###### **More Showdown Rewards**

Showdown returns with weekly rewards giving you the choice between three rewards based on how many wins you get that week. This year, you can preview the weekly rewards available in the different tiers, helping you chart your path to the increased rewards in the higher tiers.

As you reach a promotion to a new tier, you will receive new rewards immediately when you rank up. Plus, the Season Win rewards have been expanded with more rewards for more wins.

###### **Domination Update**

Domination now features new looks and formats, and a new reward called Crests. Every Domination game now includes an extra challenge available at the 3 Star difficulty. Complete the challenge and win by the listed score differential to unlock that game’s Crest. If you complete all 99 stars and all 33 Crests in a Domination, you’ll earn a reward worthy of its ultimate players.

Domination will launch with two sets this year representing the current NBA and the current WNBA leagues. As previously mentioned, WNBA Domination will need your lineup to be full of WNBA players to be eligible.

###### **New Player Card View**

Viewing, upgrading, or swapping your Player Cards has never looked so good in MyTEAM. When you click the right stick to view a card, it will expand into different layers that reveal attributes, Badges, Shoes, and Evolution requirements while the player is added to the menu replacing the photo cutout. This is your new one-stop-shop for editing your Player Cards.

This new Player Card view is also featured whenever you swap cards in a lineup. Improved attribute comparisons give you a quick way to compare strengths and weaknesses of different cards, along with both players on screen.

###### **Favorite Cards in Your Collection**

Use the new Favorite feature to bookmark Player Cards and bring them to the forefront of your collection when swapping players. A new Autofill with Favorite Players has been added to quickly add these players to a new lineup, and they will be on display in the My Collection menu as well.

###### **Presentation Updates to Eras**

Triple Threat and Clutch Time era games in Breakout and Challenges now have historic court floors to match the Eras filter and opponents for that game. Plus, some new screen filters have been added for a unique twist in Challenge games. Clutch Time across MyTEAM is also returning to a 14 second shot clock, based on community feedback.

![Presentation Updates to Eras](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/3NaraRkZXtfAZCB2OMr1Cc/a9eaa1adc33f88c3e3cc4d861b1d6536/N26-ALL-PRESENTATION_UPDATE_TO_ERAS-NA-STATIC-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-466x828-FINAL.jpg)

###### **Cinematic Walkout Reveals**

Still-frames are out and cinematic player walkout reveals are back, and now supporting two or more players walking out to celebrate together!

![Walkout ](https://assets.2k.com/1a6ngf98576c/1E0IajhfJa4i4uqqN5P1io/c9eb31f5c4b886b8a64ec689295c2b71/N25-ALL-WALK_OUT_REVEALS-NA-06-ENUS-NO_RATING-AGN-1920x1080-FINAL.gif)

## COMING UP NEXT

Unite stars in MyTEAM this year with NBA and WNBA Player Cards. Collect players from both leagues and form never-before-seen lineup combinations. We can’t wait to see what the community comes up with—and we can’t wait to share what’s coming down the pipeline.

In case you missed, see what’s new in the [MyPLAYER Builder Courtside Report](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/courtside-report/myplayer-builder/), and keep an eye out for The W Courtside Report.

Get up to 7 days of Early Access\*\*\* when you [pre-order](https://nba.2k.com/2k26/buy/) the _Superstar_ or _Leave No Doubt Edition_, and receive additional bonus content!
